decisive_items: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma diagnosed 4 years ago
diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium
response.rationale: The patient has a history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and now presents with right atrial masses and hypermetabolic activity on PET-CT, strongly indicating secondary cardiac lymphoma. The ECG and elevated biomarkers are nonspecific, while the imaging findings are most consistent with lymphomatous involvement rather than chemotherapy-induced cardiomyopathy or amyloidosis.

rejected.why: Chemotherapy-induced cardiomyopathy would typically cause global systolic dysfunction and not focal right atrial masses with increased FDG uptake on PET-CT.
Cardiac amyloidosis would not produce discrete hypermetabolic right atrial masses; the imaging and prior lymphoma history make amyloidosis unlikely.
